name: watchlist_sweep_keeps_price_20261107
comment: ANCHOR: WATCHLIST_SWEEP_KEEPS_PRICE_20261107 — LQ-20261107-56: the watchlist enrichment sweep must not overwrite a known price or
change% with NULL when a price lookup fails; the row is marked stale instead, through the sweep's single UPDATE.
LQ-20261107-273 extends the same guarantee: the kept price carries the time it was OBSERVED (price_observed_at,
not the attempt time last_enriched_at), and the failed lookup is recorded separately (price_lookup_failed_at).
